name: Pols 15
tagline: Upload a policy and twelve agents simulate how demographic groups react, map the impact and draft your public position.

awards: Track: Agentverse - Search & Discovery of Agents

problem: Campaigns and advocates cannot cheaply test how a policy lands with different groups.
solution: A Fetch.ai orchestrator runs entity-extraction, configuration and seven demographic-cluster agents that debate the policy, shows impact zones on a 3D globe, a stakeholder graph and in-character constituent chat, and drafts social posts.
demo_moment: Team-described: upload a policy PDF, click a cluster on the globe and question its persona.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “Track: Agentverse - Search & Discovery of Agents” among 307 submissions.
Twelve cooperating agents built by a one-person team.

lessons: Simulated personas become useful when the user can question one directly.
